create_pixel_grid: create a pixel coordinate grid tensor with given height and width using get_pixel_grids
create_reverse_pixel_grid: create a reverse pixel coordinate grid with +X left and +Y up convention
project_3d_points: project 3D batch points from world space to camera pixel coordinates using K and world2cam matrices
convert_screen_to_ndc: convert screen-space coordinates to normalized device coordinates for given height and width
test_project_batch: test the project_batch function with sample 3D points, camera intrinsics, and world-to-cam transforms
